scripts.release:patch: npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && npm run build
scripts.android:prepare: npm run build && npm run check:release && node scripts/build-android.mjs
scripts.android:sync: npm run android:prepare && cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && node scripts/run-android.mjs assembleDebug
scripts.android:bundle: npm run android:sync && node scripts/run-android.mjs bundleRelease
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && node scripts/run-android.mjs assembleRelease && python3 scripts/sign-android-apk.py
